title: Umbraco package compatibility override (one package)
description: One file per package in overrides/<package-id-lowercase>.yml. NuGet range syntax and the file-name rule are checked by tools/compile.cs, which uses the same parser as Umbraco.Community.PackageCheck.

id.description: The NuGet package id as the author publishes it. Compared case-insensitively.

packageVersions.description: NuGet version range of the package this entry is about.

umbraco.description: NuGet version range of the Umbraco versions this entry is about.

evidence.description: A public https link: an issue on the package's repo, a forum post or a reproduction.

reviewBy.description: Shown as stale after this date. Defaults to 12 months after verifiedOn.

replacement.description: Optional package id that replaces this one.
